caveats: One Q028 sub-case does not represent all 125 questions.

no_improvement_findings: Objective holdout metrics are identical to FULL_SYSTEM when the same authorized threshold is applied by the deterministic kernel.

proposed_change.justification: Round 1 malignant_recall is 0.9286, which is below the target of 0.95. Lowering the decision threshold from 0.5 to 0.4 increases sensitivity for the positive class (malignant), aiming to push malignant_recall above the 0.95 target while remaining within the allowed_revision_policy.
